+ /// Smooth mouse movement and visual highlighting for agent-controlled actions
+ use core_graphics::{
+     event::{CGEvent, CGEventType},
+     event_source::{CGEventSource, CGEventSourceStateID},
+     geometry::CGPoint,
+     display::CGDisplay,
+     mouse::CGMouseButton,
+     event_tap::CGEventTapLocation,
+ };
+ use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
+ use tracing::{debug, info, warn};
+ use crate::platforms::macos::interaction::create_adjusted_point;
+ use crate::errors::AutomationError;
+ 
+ /// Configuration for smooth mouse movement
+ #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+ pub struct SmoothMouseConfig {
+     /// Speed of mouse movement (pixels per millisecond)
+     pub speed: f64,
+     /// Minimum duration for any movement (milliseconds)
+     pub min_duration_ms: u64,
+     /// Maximum duration for any movement (milliseconds)
+     pub max_duration_ms: u64,
+     /// Pause between each movement step (milliseconds)
+     pub step_delay_ms: u64,
+     /// Whether to enable visual highlighting
+     pub enable_highlighting: bool,
+     /// Duration to show highlight before movement (milliseconds)
+     pub highlight_duration_ms: u64,
+ }
+ 
+ impl Default for SmoothMouseConfig {
+     fn default() -> Self {
+         Self {
+             speed: 3.0,  // 3 pixels per millisecond = moderate speed
+             min_duration_ms: 300,  // At least 300ms for any movement
+             max_duration_ms: 2000, // At most 2 seconds for any movement
+             step_delay_ms: 16,     // ~60fps smooth movement
+             enable_highlighting: true,
+             highlight_duration_ms: 500, // Show highlight for 500ms before moving
+         }
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Visual cursor highlighter for agent actions
+ pub struct CursorHighlighter {
+     highlight_window: Option<HighlightWindow>,
+ }
+ 
+ /// Represents a visual highlight overlay for the cursor
+ struct HighlightWindow {
+     // We'll implement this with a transparent overlay window
+     // For now, we'll use a simple approach with drawing on screen
+     position: CGPoint,
+     created_at: Instant,
+ }
+ 
+ impl CursorHighlighter {
+     pub fn new() -> Self {
+         Self {
+             highlight_window: None,
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     /// Show a visual highlight at the specified coordinates
+     pub fn show_highlight(&mut self, x: f64, y: f64, duration_ms: u64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         info!("Showing cursor highlight at ({}, {}) for {}ms", x, y, duration_ms);
+         
+         // For macOS, we'll use a combination of techniques:
+         // 1. Temporary cursor size increase (if possible)
+         // 2. Visual overlay (simplified approach for now)
+         
+         let point = create_adjusted_point(x, y)?;
+         
+         // Store highlight info
+         self.highlight_window = Some(HighlightWindow {
+             position: point,
+             created_at: Instant::now(),
+         });
+ 
+         // Create a brief visual indication by rapidly moving cursor in small circle
+         // This creates a visible "pulse" effect that users can easily see
+         self.create_pulse_effect(point)?;
+         
+         // Schedule cleanup after duration
+         std::thread::spawn(move || {
+             std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(duration_ms));
+             // Highlight will be automatically cleaned up when replaced or dropped
+         });
+ 
+         Ok(())
+     }
+ 
+     /// Create a pulse effect by briefly moving cursor in a small pattern
+     fn create_pulse_effect(&self, center: CGPoint) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         let source = CGEventSource::new(CGEventSourceStateID::HIDSystemState)
+             .map_err(|_| AutomationError::PlatformError("Failed to create event source for pulse".to_string()))?;
+ 
+         let pulse_radius = 15.0; // Small radius for pulse effect
+         let steps = 8; // Number of steps in the pulse circle
+         
+         for i in 0..steps {
+             let angle = (i as f64) * (2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI) / (steps as f64);
+             let pulse_x = center.x + pulse_radius * angle.cos();
+             let pulse_y = center.y + pulse_radius * angle.sin();
+             let pulse_point = CGPoint::new(pulse_x, pulse_y);
+             
+             let move_event = CGEvent::new_mouse_event(
+                 source.clone(),
+                 CGEventType::MouseMoved,
+                 pulse_point,
+                 CGMouseButton::Left,
+             ).map_err(|_| AutomationError::PlatformError("Failed to create pulse move event".to_string()))?;
+             
+             move_event.post(CGEventTapLocation::HID);
+             std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(25)); // Fast pulse
+         }
+         
+         // Return to center
+         let center_event = CGEvent::new_mouse_event(
+             source,
+             CGEventType::MouseMoved,
+             center,
+             CGMouseButton::Left,
+         ).map_err(|_| AutomationError::PlatformError("Failed to create center move event".to_string()))?;
+         
+         center_event.post(CGEventTapLocation::HID);
+         
+         Ok(())
+     }
+ 
+     /// Hide any active highlight
+     pub fn hide_highlight(&mut self) {
+         if self.highlight_window.is_some() {
+             debug!("Hiding cursor highlight");
+             self.highlight_window = None;
+         }
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Smooth mouse movement implementation
+ pub struct SmoothMouseMover {
+     config: SmoothMouseConfig,
+     highlighter: CursorHighlighter,
+ }
+ 
+ impl SmoothMouseMover {
+     pub fn new(config: SmoothMouseConfig) -> Self {
+         Self {
+             config,
+             highlighter: CursorHighlighter::new(),
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     pub fn with_default_config() -> Self {
+         Self::new(SmoothMouseConfig::default())
+     }
+ 
+     /// Perform a smooth mouse movement from current position to target
+     pub fn smooth_move_to(&mut self, target_x: f64, target_y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         // Get current cursor position
+         let current = self.get_current_position()?;
+         self.smooth_move_from_to(current.0, current.1, target_x, target_y)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Perform a smooth mouse movement from start to end position
+     pub fn smooth_move_from_to(&mut self, start_x: f64, start_y: f64, end_x: f64, end_y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         let start_point = create_adjusted_point(start_x, start_y)?;
+         let end_point = create_adjusted_point(end_x, end_y)?;
+         
+         // Calculate movement parameters
+         let distance = ((end_point.x - start_point.x).powi(2) + (end_point.y - start_point.y).powi(2)).sqrt();
+         let duration_ms = self.calculate_movement_duration(distance);
+         
+         info!("Smooth mouse movement: ({:.1}, {:.1}) → ({:.1}, {:.1}), distance: {:.1}px, duration: {}ms", 
+               start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, distance, duration_ms);
+ 
+         // Show highlight at destination if enabled
+         if self.config.enable_highlighting {
+             self.highlighter.show_highlight(end_x, end_y, self.config.highlight_duration_ms)?;
+             std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(self.config.highlight_duration_ms));
+         }
+ 
+         // Perform smooth movement
+         self.execute_smooth_movement(start_point, end_point, duration_ms)?;
+         
+         // Hide highlight after movement
+         if self.config.enable_highlighting {
+             self.highlighter.hide_highlight();
+         }
+         
+         Ok(())
+     }
+ 
+     /// Execute the actual smooth movement between two points
+     fn execute_smooth_movement(&self, start: CGPoint, end: CGPoint, duration_ms: u64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         let source = CGEventSource::new(CGEventSourceStateID::HIDSystemState)
+             .map_err(|_| AutomationError::PlatformError("Failed to create event source for smooth movement".to_string()))?;
+ 
+         let total_steps = duration_ms / self.config.step_delay_ms;
+         let step_delay = Duration::from_millis(self.config.step_delay_ms);
+         
+         debug!("Executing smooth movement with {} steps, {}ms between steps", total_steps, self.config.step_delay_ms);
+         
+         for step in 0..=total_steps {
+             let progress = if total_steps == 0 { 1.0 } else { step as f64 / total_steps as f64 };
+             
+             // Use easing for more natural movement (ease-in-out)
+             let eased_progress = self.ease_in_out(progress);
+             
+             let current_x = start.x + (end.x - start.x) * eased_progress;
+             let current_y = start.y + (end.y - start.y) * eased_progress;
+             let current_point = CGPoint::new(current_x, current_y);
+             
+             let move_event = CGEvent::new_mouse_event(
+                 source.clone(),
+                 CGEventType::MouseMoved,
+                 current_point,
+                 CGMouseButton::Left,
+             ).map_err(|_| AutomationError::PlatformError("Failed to create smooth move event".to_string()))?;
+             
+             move_event.post(CGEventTapLocation::HID);
+             
+             if step < total_steps {
+                 std::thread::sleep(step_delay);
+             }
+         }
+         
+         Ok(())
+     }
+ 
+     /// Calculate appropriate duration for movement based on distance
+     fn calculate_movement_duration(&self, distance: f64) -> u64 {
+         let calculated_duration = (distance / self.config.speed) as u64;
+         calculated_duration
+             .max(self.config.min_duration_ms)
+             .min(self.config.max_duration_ms)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Ease-in-out function for natural movement
+     fn ease_in_out(&self, t: f64) -> f64 {
+         if t < 0.5 {
+             2.0 * t * t
+         } else {
+             -1.0 + (4.0 - 2.0 * t) * t
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get current cursor position
+     fn get_current_position(&self) -> Result<(f64, f64), AutomationError> {
+         crate::platforms::macos::interaction::get_cursor_position()
+     }
+ 
+     /// Perform a smooth click with highlighting
+     pub fn smooth_click(&mut self, x: f64, y: f64, click_type: ClickType) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         // Move to position smoothly
+         self.smooth_move_to(x, y)?;
+         
+         // Brief pause before clicking
+         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
+         
+         // Perform the click
+         match click_type {
+             ClickType::Left => self.perform_left_click(x, y)?,
+             ClickType::Right => self.perform_right_click(x, y)?,
+             ClickType::Double => self.perform_double_click(x, y)?,
+             ClickType::Middle => self.perform_middle_click(x, y)?,
+         }
+         
+         Ok(())
+     }
+ 
+     fn perform_left_click(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         crate::platforms::macos::interaction::left_click(x, y, None)
+     }
+ 
+     fn perform_right_click(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         crate::platforms::macos::interaction::right_click(x, y)
+     }
+ 
+     fn perform_double_click(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         crate::platforms::macos::interaction::double_click(x, y)
+     }
+ 
+     fn perform_middle_click(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+         crate::platforms::macos::interaction::middle_click(x, y)
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Types of mouse clicks supported
+ #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
+ pub enum ClickType {
+     Left,
+     Right,
+     Double,
+     Middle,
+ }
+ 
+ /// Global smooth mouse mover instance
+ static mut GLOBAL_SMOOTH_MOUSE: Option<SmoothMouseMover> = None;
+ static SMOOTH_MOUSE_INIT: std::sync::Once = std::sync::Once::new();
+ 
+ /// Get or initialize the global smooth mouse mover
+ pub fn get_smooth_mouse_mover() -> &'static mut SmoothMouseMover {
+     unsafe {
+         SMOOTH_MOUSE_INIT.call_once(|| {
+             GLOBAL_SMOOTH_MOUSE = Some(SmoothMouseMover::with_default_config());
+         });
+         GLOBAL_SMOOTH_MOUSE.as_mut().unwrap()
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Configure the global smooth mouse settings
+ pub fn configure_smooth_mouse(config: SmoothMouseConfig) {
+     unsafe {
+         GLOBAL_SMOOTH_MOUSE = Some(SmoothMouseMover::new(config));
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Convenience functions for smooth mouse operations
+ pub fn smooth_move_to(x: f64, y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+     get_smooth_mouse_mover().smooth_move_to(x, y)
+ }
+ 
+ pub fn smooth_left_click(x: f64, y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+     get_smooth_mouse_mover().smooth_click(x, y, ClickType::Left)
+ }
+ 
+ pub fn smooth_right_click(x: f64, y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+     get_smooth_mouse_mover().smooth_click(x, y, ClickType::Right)
+ }
+ 
+ pub fn smooth_double_click(x: f64, y: f64) -> Result<(), AutomationError> {
+     get_smooth_mouse_mover().smooth_click(x, y, ClickType::Double)
+ }
